blocks.text: Breakfast, then a 4-hour tour: the cable car to Morro da Urca, with its wide observation deck, and on to Sugar Loaf, with views of Copacabana, the bay, the islands, the bridge to Niterói and Christ the Redeemer, then old Rio, with its historic churches, monasteries, Metropolitan Cathedral and colonial buildings. In the evening, you can have dinner at Fogo de Chão, the Brazilian steakhouse overlooking Sugar Loaf (around USD 75).

blocks.text:
You can add a helicopter flight lasting 10 to 30 minutes. After take-off, the city streets, beaches and yachts in the bay lie below you. The route passes over Ipanema, Leblon, Copacabana, the Botanical Garden, Rodrigo de Freitas Lagoon and Avenida Niemeyer. Sugar Loaf and Christ the Redeemer then come into view. From the air, you can see how closely Rio's ocean, green areas, rocky peaks and buildings sit together. Familiar places form a single panorama, with beaches stretching almost continuously along the neighbourhoods.

**Duration:** 10 to 30 minutes.

**Price:** from USD 230.

blocks.text: Day 3 · Breakfast and free time to rest before the Carnival. In the evening, transfer to the Sambadrome, where the top samba schools of Rio parade all night, competing in spectacular costumes and floats: an explosion of music, dance and emotion. Transfer back to the hotel after the parade.
